skill.name: web-design-guidelines
skill.description: Review UI files against current Web Interface Guidelines, including accessibility, UX, layout, and visual design issues.
skill.summary: Audits selected UI files against current Web Interface Guidelines with concise file and line findings.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The Markdown backtick findings are false positives caused by inline formatting and a fenced URL block, not executable Ruby or shell code. The hardcoded GitHub URL is a real low-severity network dependency, and the skill also delegates review instructions to unpinned remote content. No prompt injection text was found in the local skill file.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the guideline URL to a reviewed commit hash or vendor a trusted copy inside the skill.

remediation.issue: Remote content is treated as agent instructions
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to treat fetched guidelines as untrusted reference material and ignore operational instructions outside UI review rules.

remediation.issue: Network access is required for every review
remediation.suggestion: Document the network dependency and provide a fallback process when the source URL is unavailable.

static_findings.snippet: 4. Output findings in the terse `file:line` format

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 16 uses Markdown inline backticks around the literal output format file:line. There is no Ruby or shell execution syntax and no user-controlled command invocation.
Lines 22-24 are a Markdown fenced block containing a URL. The backticks delimit documentation text and do not execute a command.
Line 23 is a real hardcoded external URL, and the skill instructs WebFetch before each review. It does not show data exfiltration, but it creates a network dependency on mutable remote content.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Remote Instruction Source
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md instructs agents to fetch guidelines from a raw GitHub main-branch URL and says the fetched content contains rules and output instructions. This trusts unpinned remote text as agent guidance, creating a supply-chain and prompt-injection risk if the upstream file changes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 20-26 explicitly require WebFetch from a mutable URL and direct use of fetched rules. The risk is contextual supply-chain exposure rather than evidence of malicious intent.

content.user_title: Audit UI Against Web Design Guidelines
content.value_statement: UI reviews often miss accessibility, interaction, and layout issues. This skill fetches current guidelines and applies them to selected files.
actual_capabilities: Fetches Web Interface Guidelines from the configured source before a review.
Reviews user-specified files or patterns for guideline compliance.
Checks accessibility, visual design, UX, and interface best practices covered by the source rules.
Reports findings in a concise file and line format.
Asks which files to review when no target is supplied.
limitations: Requires network access to retrieve the latest guidelines.
Uses an unpinned remote guideline file, so results can change over time.
Only reviews files that the user names or pattern selects.
Does not automatically run browser tests or inspect live pages.

use_cases.title: Review a component before merge
use_cases.description: Find accessibility, spacing, state, and interaction issues in a changed UI component before code review.

use_cases.title: Audit design system updates
use_cases.description: Check shared components against current interface rules before releasing a design system change.

use_cases.title: Prepare a release quality pass
use_cases.description: Scan key interface files for actionable UX and accessibility issues before a product launch.

prompt_templates.title: Review one component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review src/components/Button.tsx against the Web Interface Guidelines and list actionable findings.

prompt_templates.title: Check a page flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of related page files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the checkout page files under src/app/checkout for accessibility, responsive layout, and interaction issues.

prompt_templates.title: Audit design system changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of shared UI primitives.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed design system components for guideline violations, then group findings by component and severity.

prompt_templates.title: Run a release interface audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across multiple product areas.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the main app navigation, dashboard, and settings files for launch-blocking interface issues. Prioritize findings that affect accessibility or task completion.

output_examples.input: Review src/components/LoginForm.tsx for Web Interface Guidelines issues.
output_examples.output: The review flags missing form labels, weak focus states, and responsive spacing concerns with concise path and line references.

output_examples.input: Audit the checkout UI files before release.
output: Findings identify contrast, tap target, and loading state issues.
Each item includes the affected file, line, and a short remediation note.

output_examples.input: Check design system button and modal changes.
output_examples.output: The review compares selected components against current guideline rules and reports only actionable interface issues.

best_practices: Provide precise file paths or patterns so the review stays focused.
Run the review after major UI changes and before release checkpoints.
Verify critical findings with manual testing and browser inspection.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a broad site review without naming files or patterns.
Do not treat the review as a replacement for accessibility testing.
Do not apply changed remote guidelines without checking the source.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews selected UI files against Web Interface Guidelines for accessibility, UX, layout, and visual design issues.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill fetches the current guideline file from the configured GitHub URL before each review.

faq.question: Can it review a live website?
faq.answer: It is designed for files and patterns. Live browser review requires separate browser testing steps.

faq.question: What tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will results always be identical?
faq.answer: No. The remote guideline source can change, so findings may vary over time.

faq.question: How should teams use the findings?
faq.answer: Use them as focused review input, then verify important accessibility and interaction issues manually.
